# Service Offering

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ServiceOffering`](gmeow-ServiceOffering.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ServiceOffering>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

A service an agent provides — consulting, support, hosting. Distinct from [`gmeow:Service`](gmeow-Service.md) (the documents-slice creative-work sense); this is the commercial service. Its kind is an open [`gmeow:ServiceType`](gmeow-ServiceType.md) value; projects to [schema:Service.](https://schema.org/Service.)
